claims.text: The MIC list gives 'HRH Prince Tu'i Pelehake (Fatafehi) CBE (1965-1991)', 'Baron Vaea of Houma (1991-2000)', 'HRH 'Aho'eitu 'Unuaki'otonga Tuku'aho (Lavaka Ata 'Ulukālala) (2000-2006)', 'Dr. Feleti Sevele (2006-2010)' and 'Lord Tu'ivakano (2010-present)'.
